// poll_interval_seconds: How often to check the Outlook calendar + local Teams windows.
// prealert_seconds: Start nagging this many seconds BEFORE meeting start (0 = exactly at start).
// renag_seconds: Re-fire toast + sound every N seconds while you remain un-joined.
// stop_after_minutes: Give up nagging this many minutes after scheduled start.
// snooze_seconds: If you click Snooze, suppress alerts for this meeting for this long.
// only_online_meetings: If true, nag only for events that are Teams online meetings. Set false to nag for ALL calendar events.
// ignore_categories: Skip events that have any of these Outlook categories (case-insensitive).
// ignore_subjects_contains: Skip events whose subject contains any of these substrings (case-insensitive).
// local_presence_enabled: If true, suppress alerts when a Teams meeting window for the event's subject is open on this PC. For meetings joined on phone / other devices, click 'I'm in it' on the toast.
// sound: Path to a .wav file to play, or 'beep' for a system beep, or '' to disable sound.
